_comment: Opt-in authored tow lanes + cart parking spot for the COUPLED restock drives. Merge the 'navigation.tow_lanes'/'navigation.directional_zone' keys into the mission runtime-config's navigation block, and the 'mission_poses.cart_parking' pose into mission_poses (the integration/bt-driver lane wires the return nav goal + uncouple step on that key). Absent => coupled drives free-plan exactly as before (byte-identical) and the braking gate uses the direction-aware zone by default. Poses are map-frame [x, y, yaw] in metres/radians; yaw PI = facing -x (west), 0 = facing +x (east). Waypoints are the authored centreline the expanded trajectory must pass through (asserted at build time). goal_articulation is the lane's achievable terminal cart articulation and governs arrival when the lane is active.
_fm437_note: tow_lane_trust_unknown (default off): on a static-validated authored lane, trust UNOBSERVED temporal-map cells in the swept envelope as free (the static map proved that corridor clear); a POSITIVE/occupied return still stops the tow. Unblocks the run-327b outbound stall at the first southward turn ('unknown_navigation_cell' over the unmapped sector south of the dock corridor).
